title: Rudolf Hess's telepathy experiments and astrologically timed flight

tellings.quote: >> he believed he was in telepathic communication with his wife while he was in prison they ran telepathy experiments

plain: Rudolf Hess, Hitler's deputy who flew to Britain in 1941 and was held prisoner there, believed he was in telepathic contact with his wife from his cell, and experiments in telepathy were run on him. A researcher named Peter Levenda tells this without naming a source, as part of a wider story that Hess's flight was itself timed by astrology.
